name: UE4SS Lua Sound Bridge
description: Sound playback for UE4SS Lua mods through a native C++ bridge: WAV files from any folder, played at once with per-play pan, volume, pitch and low-pass filter, outside the game's audio engine.

settings.Label: Enable load-time verifications
settings.Description: Runs the bridge's in-game checks when the game loads and writes PASS and FAIL lines to UE4SS.log. Takes effect on the next launch.
